HELP_TEXT:
🧭 Cultivator's guide (live-combat build):
1️⃣ 🧘 Start meditation — travel & battle lock while in trance; claiming Qi yields a Meditation Chronicle of random events.
2️⃣ ⚡️ Full Dantian → Breakthrough → seclusion & heavenly tribulation.
3️⃣ 🗺 Hunts & conquests are now live turn-based battles: techniques, talismans, pills, flee — and ⏩ fast-forward.
4️⃣ 💀 True death costs 25% Qi + meridian paralysis; a miracle escape leaves a 3-hour injury (the Restoration Pill cures).
5️⃣ 🃏 Build a deck of up to 6 techniques in the Hall; buy new manuals at the Pavilion.
6️⃣ 🎒 The spatial ring has capacity — sell or equip your loot.
7️⃣ ⛩ Sects, veins and the Dao Sovereign throne await!
